newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers wait for details of British cull.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers wait for details of British cull.

text.p: European Union farm ministers reserved judgment on Monday on British plans to increase the number of cattle to be slaughtered in a bid to erdicate BSE.

"We will do all we can to help the British farmer but we must wait to see what the minister is going to tell us tommorrow," Portugal's farm minister Fernando Gomez da Silva said as he arrived for a meeting of the farm Council.
"It is always the same question which we have had to face in the last months. At the moment I do not know what kind of question or proposition the British government is going to put to this meeting.
"We want to do all we can to help British farmers but we shall have to wait and see," he added.
The Netherland's farm minister Jozias Van Aartsen welcomed reports that British farm minister Douglas Hogg was making a statement to the House of Commons in London but said:
"We shall have to wait and see what the British minister says to us."
A spokesman for the German government said they would be making no comment until after Hogg reports on the progress of Britain's Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy eradication programme.
Hogg is due to arrive in Brussels in the early hours of Tuesday, British officials said.
